page.overview:
Who is Mizerka?

Mizerka is a Shinuchi in the Beasts Pirates. After being tamed by Tama, she became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

Mizerka is a slim young woman of average height with shoulder-length blonde hair that has tips curve upwards and she has a pair of thin and straight light-colored horns on her head which point somewhat to the sides like other Gifters.

She wears very little clothing, only wearing a light blue bra with straps around her stomach and dark boots with her waist area being covered by the gorilla Gorishiro generated with a SMILE fruit.

In her first appearance, while with the other Shinuchi, Mizerka has both arms exposed in Gorishiro's body, crossing them over her chest.
